text.en: Reviewers consistently describe the groomer as calm, friendly, and genuinely caring. Several owners of anxious or first-time dogs note that their pets were put completely at ease, with one mentioning training tips that resolved a nail-trimming issue. The relaxed atmosphere leaves dogs eager to return.

Owners across various breeds — from cockapoos and cocker spaniels to giant breeds — report being very happy with the groom. Full packages including wash, trim, nail clip, and ear clean are mentioned, and the outcome is described as looking and smelling great. Most say they will book again without hesitation.

Multiple reviewers specifically brought anxious, nervous, or difficult-to-groom dogs and found the experience far better than expected. Owners note that their dogs were perfectly calm on collection and, in one case, even tried to walk back in on non-grooming days. Advice on breed-appropriate styling is also mentioned.

q.en: Do you groom large and giant breeds?

a.en: Yes — reviews mention a Scottish Deerhound and a Dogue de Bordeaux alongside smaller breeds, with owners pleased by the handling and the outcome.

q.en: Can you handle nervous or anxious dogs?

a.en: Several reviewers brought anxious dogs and report that the groomer took her time, used training suggestions to help them relax, and returned dogs calm and happy.

q.en: What is included in a full groom?

a.en: Reviewers mention wash, trim, nail clip, and ear clean as part of a full groom. Service options and packages are listed on the salon website.

q.en: How do I book an appointment?

a.en: Bookings can be made via the salon website at thebarksidegrooms.com. The salon operates Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00–14:00.
